title: Outcomes of refractive implantable lens implantation after deep anterior lamellar keratoplasty

license.statement: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (article <license>); not CC BY, record kept private

indication: High ametropia and astigmatism after deep anterior lamellar keratoplasty (at least 6 months after suture removal); toric refractive implantable lens (hydrophilic acrylic posterior chamber phakic IOL, sulcus) through a 2.8 mm clear corneal incision without iridotomy; DALK indication not stated per eye (Introduction refers to keratoconus); retrospective, 10 eyes of 10 patients

groups.description: Toric RIL implantation in post-DALK eyes (single retrospective case series)
